title: Rust X.509 chain validation
description: Implement Rust gateway PKIX chain validation against configured trust anchors, including RFC 5280 signature/path checks, leaf basicConstraints CA=false, digitalSignature keyUsage, and no issuer-DN-only authorization. Add independent tests.
close_reason: Implemented DER X.509 chain validation with exact configured-anchor matching, issuer/subject linkage, cryptographic signature verification, leaf basicConstraints CA=false and digitalSignature, and intermediate CA/keyCertSign checks. Added independent rcgen tests for valid, unconfigured-anchor, and CA-leaf cases. Focused PKIX tests pass; full suite has one unrelated flaky resources test, clippy is blocked by pre-existing lichen-node lints; delegated reviews unavailable due insufficient reviewer-provider credits, so local three-pass review found no defects.
